results.question: Which superheroes have the highest strength in each publisher? Keep ties.
results.gold_sql: SELECT publisher_name, superhero_name FROM (SELECT p.publisher_name, s.superhero_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC) AS rk FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength') WHERE rk = 1
results.sql: SELECT publisher_name, superhero_name FROM (SELECT p.publisher_name, s.superhero_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC) AS rk FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength') WHERE rk = 1
